text:
Nora (PM): quick sync re: filter persistence when pinning model versions. Sales reports customers expect their filter set to stick when they pin a version and come back later. current behavior clears some filters. do we make pinning preserve filters, add a toggle, or leave as-is and clarify?

Lena (Design): my vote: opt-in "remember filters with pin" toggled in the pin modal. default off for now. visual affordance: small "filters saved" pill in the row next to the pin when active. keeps discovery light. :pushpin:

Omar (Frontend): technical notes: easiest path is client-side (localStorage) per-user per-model-version key like `ri:filters:v:{modelId}:{versionId}`. backend persist is more work (needs API + migration). keyboard shortcut caution: we have `p` already mapped in the compare table for pagination. avoid new global shortcuts unless we reconcile.

Ravi (Eng): agree with opt-in. fallback: if we do backend, we should namespace by org+user to avoid leaking. but localStorage + sync endpoint later is fine. also consider storage TTL and a clear UX for "stale filters".

Priya (QA): two quick QA items: 1) when filters are restored the UI must show which filters applied (clear visual state). 2) test compare overlay + pinned state across viewport sizes. regression: previously toggling view cleared focus.

Marta (A11y): accessibility nits to handle upfront: 
- Announce restore action via aria-live: "Filters restored for pinned version v1.2".
- The "filters saved" pill needs role="status" and must meet 4.5:1 contrast.
- If we add a toggle inside the pin modal, the toggle must be reachable via keyboard and have clear aria-checked state.

Omar (Frontend): sample snippet for local restore & announcement: 
```js
const key = `ri:filters:v:${modelId}:${versionId}`;
const saved = localStorage.getItem(key);
if (saved) {
  applyFilters(JSON.parse(saved));
  document.getElementById('filter-announce').textContent = `Filters restored for pinned version ${versionId}`; // aria-live element
}
// on pin: localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(currentFilters));
```

Lena (Design): microcopy proposals:
- pin tooltip: "Pin version — optionally remember filters"
- toggle label: "Remember filters when this version is pinned"
- banner copy (temporary): "Note: switching pinned versions will clear some filters. Enable 'Remember filters' to keep them."

Ravi (Eng): UX edge-case: what happens when saved filters reference a filter that's since been deleted (eg facet removed)? prefer graceful ignore + show a tiny toast: "One filter was removed from saved set."

Priya (QA): add tests for that toast + voiceover reading of it. also include keyboard-only flow: open pin modal, toggle remember, confirm, then use keyboard to navigate back to catalog and ensure filters persist.

Nora (PM): decision for this sprint: implement client-side opt-in (localStorage) + UX banner and pill. backend persistence scoped to next quarter. Omar and Lena will ship prototype to dev env; Priya & Marta will run quick QA/a11y passes. Ravi to create engineering ticket.

ticket-bot: Ticket #2567 created by Ravi: "Pin remembers filters (client opt-in) - prototype" — https://tickets.internal/2567 :white_check_mark:

Marta (A11y): quick checklist before merge: aria-live present, pill contrast >= 4.5, toggle has aria attributes, keyboard focus preserved after restore. i'll review PR. :mag_right:

Lena (Design): i'll upload two mocks (modal with toggle + pinned row pill) in Figma this afternoon and annotate contrast tokens.

Omar (Frontend): i'll scope PR for next-week sprint, will avoid adding new global keyboard shortcuts. will include TTL of 90 days for local storage keys and a one-time migration note in UX.

Nora (PM): thanks all. follow-ups: Figma link, PR link, and QA checklist. aiming for dev deploy next Thursday. :calendar:
